messages:
Maya S: starting onboarding for customer Delta finetune (LoRA) — quick smoke shows currency cents disappearing in some replies. uploaded evalpack: delta-currency-quick-v1 :link:
Ibrahim: put example prompt and output?
Maya S: prompt 0021: 'Balance due: $2,718.28' -> model returns '2718' or '2,718' (no cents) intermittently under long context.
Kai: could be tokenizer id mismatch or quantization aliasing. Did their training use a custom tokenizer?
Maya S: yes, they trained with cust_delta_tok_v3. the LoRA archive includes tokenizer.json but we didn't rebase token ids on merge.
Ibrahim: run a quick tokenmap diff: `python tools/tokenmap_diff.py --base models/umbra-base/tokenizer.json --other customer/tokenizers/cust_delta_tok_v3.json`
Ibrahim: diff shows punctuation and digit-related ids moved (e.g., `"$": 345 -> 1023`, `".": 56 -> 512`).
Kai: that explains it. LoRA patch applies to embedding indices; if token ids shifted then numeric tokens map to wrong vectors and cents can vanish.
Maya S: there's a helper `scripts/rebase_lora_tokenids.py --lora path/to/lora.safetensors --target-tokenizer customer/tokenizers/cust_delta_tok_v3.json --out remapped_lora.safetensors` — should remap embedding keys.
Ibrahim: plan: 1) baseline fp16 run, 2) int4 quant run without remap, 3) int4 with remap. I'll schedule on dedicated-gpu-3.
EvalBot: quick-eval queued (job ej-100012) on dedicated-gpu-3. ETA ~10m.
Kai: also add a tiny assertion in smoke harness: for currency prompts assert regex cents present `\d+\.\d{2}` in generated numeric fields.
Maya S: good idea — I'll add test tests/smoke/currency_cents.test in PR.
EvalBot: job complete: fp16 cents preserved 99.2%, int4 w/o remap 72.5%, int4 with remap 95.8%. full logs at /mnt/results/ej-100012/summary.json
Ibrahim: strong signal. remap recovers most regressions — we should make remapping part of onboarding when tokenizer mismatch detected and optionally document `--skip-rebase`.
Maya S: drafting PR for the onboarding pipeline to auto-detect tokenizer mismatch and run remap step. tagging Kai for review.
ops-bot: reserved dedicated-gpu-3 for 2025-06-02T01:00:00Z to 2025-06-02T03:00:00Z for full validation  res-75522
Kai: nice. add a checklist item to onboarding: "tokenizer diff + remap if needed". saved a customer rollout.
